content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Air Force Physical Security System (budget line item 834130) is a U.S. Air Force procurement line funded in the Other Procurement, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "f07ee3763f6a6716"}}, {"text": "The Air Force Physical Security System (AFPSS) program procures force-protection equipment and supports installation, integration, and acceptance testing for base-defense physical security systems such as the Integrated Base Defense Security System (IBDSS), Counter-Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-sUAS), and Counter-Rockets, Artillery and Mortar (C-RAM) systems.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a239797e23c44b0d"}}, {"text": "The program's purpose is to deliver modern, secure base-defense solutions that protect people, infrastructure, facilities, and the Nation's most critical warfighting assets, both in the homeland and overseas.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a239797e23c44b0d"}}, {"text": "AFPSS spans several underlying program elements, including B-21 Raider electronic security systems, Air Launched Cruise Missile security systems, LGM-35A Sentinel Squadrons security systems, and Long Range Standoff (LRSO) weapon security systems for nuclear warhead storage and Special Access Program facilities.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a239797e23c44b0d"}}, {"text": "In FY2026 the line adds new starts, including the Long Range Standoff Weapon security systems and IBDSS-4 (Capability Improvement); funding for LGM-35A Sentinel facilities is described as critical to meeting nuclear certification and weapon-system deployment timelines.", "citation": {"fact_id": "48eb281467abcf3a"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The line's total FY2026 request is $992,947 thousand (about $993 million), up from $358,000 thousand (about $358 million) enacted in FY2025.", "citation": {"fact_id": "f07ee3763f6a6716"}}, {"text": "The FY2026 request splits into a discretionary request of $294,747 thousand (about $295 million) and a reconciliation (mandatory) request of $698,200 thousand (about $698 million).", "citation": {"fact_id": "7c06d2824fd39538"}}, {"text": "The $698,200 thousand reconciliation request is additional mandatory funding on top of the discretionary base, together making up the line's $992,947 thousand FY2026 total — so most of the FY2026 money is mandatory.", "citation": {"fact_id": "bb28bf0f420cf0a3"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the line recorded actual obligations of $287,875 thousand (about $288 million), so the FY2026 total is more than three times that recent execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "f733f4edf2d9c6c0"}}, {"text": "The program's own budget narrative states that Overseas Operations Costs fund part of this requirement in FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a239797e23c44b0d"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Other Procurement, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "7c06d2824fd39538"}}, {"text": "In FY2026 the program funds physical security systems and associated equipment for new LGM-35A Sentinel facilities, including the Vandenberg Space Force Base Formal Training Unit and Reentry Vehicle Facility, the F.E. Warren Air Force Base Integrated Training Center, and the Malmstrom Air Force Base Commercial Gate.", "citation": {"fact_id": "48eb281467abcf3a"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
